description: Save a named multi-step skill chain (generate → edit → upscale …). String args may contain {{input.<key>}} and {{prev}} placeholders. Saving to an existing name overwrites it.

description.description: Optional note on what the workflow does (max 500 chars).

name.description: Kebab-case handle, 2-41 chars (e.g. "product-launch-pack"). Saving to an existing name overwrites it.

steps.description: The chain, 1-8 steps, run in order. Saving charges nothing; running charges each step.

args.description: That tool's own arguments, exactly as you would pass them calling it directly. Any string value, at any depth, may contain {{input.<key>}} (filled from pixeldojo_run_workflow inputs) or {{prev}} (the first asset URL the previous step produced).

skill.description: Tool this step runs. Steps run in order when the workflow runs, and each is charged at that tool's own rate.

name: pixeldojo_save_workflow
title: Save workflow
